inline_comments.comment: This sets the bump type to `major`, which is far too aggressive for a documentation-only addition to the community integrations list. A `major` bump signals a breaking change to downstream consumers. Per project convention, adding a feature warrants `minor`; a doc-only addition arguably warrants `patch` at most. Please downgrade this to `minor` or `patch`.

The changeset description contains a typo: `marmaid.js` should be `mermaid.js`. Additionally, per project convention the first word after the `feat:` prefix should be capitalized — change `feat: add doc` to `feat: Add doc`.

This file is an exact duplicate of `.changeset/full-clubs-learn.md` (same bump type and same description). Per project convention, each `.changeset/*.md` file should cover changes for exactly one package, and only one changeset per package per MR is needed. Delete this duplicate file.

This is a third changeset file for the same `mermaid` package in the same MR, conflicting with the `major` bump declared in the other two changesets. Only one changeset per package is needed per MR. Consolidate into a single file and remove this one and the duplicate.

The bump type `patch` directly contradicts the `feat:` conventional-commit prefix used in the description on line 5. Per project convention, `feat:` additions should use the `minor` bump type. If this is purely a documentation/chore change with no user-facing API impact, the prefix should instead be `chore:` with a `patch` bump.
Typo: `marmaid.js` should be `mermaid.js`. Also, per project convention the first word after the prefix should be capitalized: `feat: Add doc …` not `feat: add doc …`.

The `docs/` directory is auto-generated from `packages/mermaid/src/docs/`. The source file adds only one sub-item (`octave_mermaid_js`), but this generated file has five sub-items (`Octave Repo Index`, `News`, `Source Code`, `Function Reference`, `Bug Tracker`). These are inconsistent, which indicates the generated file was edited manually rather than regenerated from the source. The generated file should not be hand-edited; update the source file in `packages/mermaid/src/docs/` with the desired content, then regenerate `docs/`.

Sub-items labeled `News`, `Source Code`, and `Bug Tracker` (lines 62–65) are generic category names, not product or plugin names. Per project convention, link text should use the integration's full official product name so entries unambiguously identify the specific product. Consider replacing these with the project name `octave_mermaid_js` (possibly with a clarifying suffix) and reducing the number of sub-items to match the level of detail other entries in this list provide.

general_comments.comment: There are three changeset files in this PR (`.changeset/7123.md`, `.changeset/full-clubs-learn.md`, `.changeset/true-parrots-build.md`), all targeting the same `mermaid` package. Per project convention, a single MR should produce exactly one changeset per package. Two of the three files declare a `major` bump — entirely inappropriate for adding a documentation entry — while the third declares `patch` with a `feat:` prefix, which is also contradictory. Please delete two of the three files and align the remaining one: if this is treated as a feature addition, use `minor`; if it is treated as a documentation chore, use `chore:` with `patch`.
All three changeset files contain the same typo in the project name: `marmaid.js` should be `mermaid.js`. This typo also appears in the PR title and description. Please correct it throughout.
